items.source: Return the set of methods for this type. The default implementation returns the result of Class.getMethods() for the given type, but subclasses may override in order to alter the results, for example, specifying static methods declared elsewhere.
items.translation: 返回该类型的Method集合。默认实现针对给定的type返回Class.getMethods()的结果，但子类可以重写该方法以改变结果，例如指定在其他地方声明的静态方法。

items.source: Register a filter for methods on the given type.
items.translation: 为给定类型上的方法注册一个过滤器。

items.source:
This constructor allows the ReflectiveMethodResolver to be configured such that it
will use a distance computation to check which is the better of two close matches
(when there are multiple matches). Using the distance computation is intended to
ensure matches are more closely representative of what a Java compiler would do
when taking into account boxing/unboxing and whether the method candidates are
declared to handle a supertype of the type (of the argument) being passed in.
items.translation: 此构造函数允许配置 ReflectiveMethodResolver，使其在存在多个匹配项时，使用距离计算来检查哪一个是两个相近匹配中的更优选项。使用距离计算的目的是确保匹配结果更能代表 Java 编译器在处理装箱/拆箱以及方法候选者是否声明为处理传入参数类型的超类型时所采取的行为。

items.source: useDistance - true if distance computation should be used when calculating matches; false otherwise
items.translation: useDistance - 计算匹配时是否使用距离计算；true 表示是，false 表示否。

items.source: filter - the corresponding method filter, or null to clear any filter for the given type
items.translation: filter - 对应的过滤方法，或 null 以清除给定类型的任何过滤器。

items.source: type - the type to filter on
items.translation: type - 用于过滤的类型

items.source: type - the class for which to return the methods
items.translation: type - 要返回其方法的类。

items.source: Andy Clement, Juergen Hoeller, Chris Beams, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Andy Clement，Juergen Hoeller，Chris Beams，Sam Brannen

items.source: The default implementation considers any method as a candidate, even for static methods and non-user-declared methods on the Object base class.
items.translation: 默认实现会将任何方法都视为候选项，即使这些方法是静态方法或 `Object` 基类上的非用户声明方法。

items.source: There are three kinds of matches that might occur:
items.translation: 可能会出现三种类型的匹配：

items.source: Reflection-based MethodResolver used by default in StandardEvaluationContext unless explicit method resolvers have been specified.
items.translation: 基于反射的MethodResolver在StandardEvaluationContext中默认使用，除非已指定显式的方法解析器。

items.source: Determine whether the given Method is a candidate for method resolution on an instance of the given target class.
items.translation: 确定给定的Method是否为给定目标类实例的方法解析候选项。

items.source:
This constructor allows the ReflectiveMethodResolver to be configured such that it
will use a distance computation to check which is the better of two close matches
(when there are multiple matches).
items.translation: 此构造函数允许配置 `ReflectiveMethodResolver`，使其在存在多个匹配项时使用距离计算来检查两个相近匹配中哪一个更优。

items.source: Return the set of methods for this type.
items.translation: 返回该类型的Method集合。

items.source: Locate a method on the type.
items.translation: 在类型上定位一个方法。

items.source: resolve in interface MethodResolver
items.translation: `resolve` 接口 `MethodResolver` 中

items.source: a MethodExecutor that can invoke the method, or null if the method cannot be found
items.translation: 一个可以调用该方法的 `MethodExecutor`，或者如果找不到该方法则为 `null`。

items.source: context - the current evaluation context
items.translation: context - 当前评估上下文

items.source: targetObject - the object upon which the method is being called
items.translation: targetObject - 该方法调用的对象

items.source: name - the name of the method
items.translation: name - 方法名称

items.source: argumentTypes - the types of arguments that the method must be able to handle
items.translation: argumentTypes - 该方法必须能够处理的参数类型

items.source: method - the Method to evaluate
items.translation: method - 要评估的 Method

items.source: targetClass - the concrete target class that is being introspected
items.translation: targetClass - 正在被内省的具象目标类

items.source:
An exact match where the types of the arguments match the types of the
method.
items.translation: 参数类型与方法类型完全匹配的确切匹配。

items.source:
An inexact match where the types we are looking for are subtypes of
those defined on the method.
items.translation: 我们寻找的类型是方法定义中类型的子类型时的不精确匹配。

items.source:
A match where we are able to convert the arguments into those expected
by the method, according to the registered type converter.
items.translation: 能够根据已注册的类型转换器将参数转换为方法所期望类型的匹配项。
